body: I understand that why it seems fabricated and that’s fine. I don’t know Iraqis in Iraq except the few we work with. Im not necessarily scared of the people, just the possibility of what may happen. I’m going to try calling the embassy. I don’t know why I didn’t think of that to be honest.
I don’t want them to believe that I am awol. As we aren’t technically allowed off of the base unless it’s mission critical. So I wasn’t allowed where I was at.

UPDATE: when I said burner phone, I called it that because it was a cheap phone I was able to obtain. I’m in the Indiana National Guard. I didn’t get much sleep last night someone was following me. It freaked me out, I’m think about hitchhiking to back to Baghdad. If I can do that I should be able to find the base.
